2607.12687.title: From Critic to Confidence: PPO for Language-Based Quantitative Prediction with Confidence Estimation
2607.12687.paper_summary: LLMs can perform language-based quantitative prediction from unstructured inputs, but remain susceptible to hallucinations and overconfident errors, making it critical to know not only what a model predicts, but when its predictions can be trusted. We introduce CARE-PPO, a reinforcement learning framework that establishes a connection between loss prediction for uncertainty estimation and actor-critic PPO fine-tuning, enabling joint learning of accurate numerical estimates and reliable confidence signals in language-based quantitative prediction. CARE-PPO uses a Confidence-Aligned Reward for Estimation, defined as a function of prediction error, to provide dense error-aware feedback to the actor while inducing the critic to learn a value function aligned with prediction quality. During inference, we repurpose the critic as a confidence estimator. Across two real-world tasks in healthcare and finance and two Qwen-3 model scales (4B and 8B), CARE-PPO achieves strong quantitative prediction performance, while producing significantly better-aligned confidence estimates through the critic than logit-based and verbalized baselines. These gains persist under realistic out-of-distribution settings across domains, spanning linguistic and domain shifts. Finally, CARE-PPO reduces task-specific overfitting on general instruction-following prompts, consistent with the broader generalization advantages of RL fine-tuning over supervised approaches.
2607.12687.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 可以從非結構化輸入中執行基於語言的定量預測，但仍然容易受到幻覺和過度自信錯誤的影響，因此了解模型的預測內容以及何時可以信任這些預測至關重要。我們介紹了 CARE-PPO，一個強化學習框架，建立了不確定性估計的損失預測與演員-評論家 PPO 微調之間的聯繫，使得在基於語言的定量預測中能夠共同學習準確的數值估計和可靠的信心信號。CARE-PPO 使用一種稱為估計的信心對齊獎勵，這是一個基於預測誤差的函數，為演員提供密集的錯誤感知反饋，同時促使評論家學習與預測質量對齊的價值函數。在推理過程中，我們將評論家重新用作信心估計器。在醫療和金融的兩個真實世界任務以及兩個 Qwen-3 模型規模（4B 和 8B）中，CARE-PPO 實現了強大的定量預測性能，同時通過評論家產生的信心估計顯著優於基於邏輯和口頭表達的基準。這些增益在跨領域的現實分佈外設置下持續存在，涵蓋了語言和領域的變化。最後，CARE-PPO 減少了在一般指令跟隨提示上的任務特定過擬合，這與 RL 微調相對於監督方法的更廣泛泛化優勢一致。
